source:
🎮 Complete Game Design & Concept Prompt
Core Style & Visuals:
Graphics Quality: AAA High-End Graphics, Ultra-Realistic 4K textures, dynamic lighting, cinematic visuals.
Environment & Atmosphere: Perpetual night setting. A dynamic 4K night sky featuring a large, glowing pale-blue moon (instead of white) casting subtle light onto castles and small houses. Volumetric dark clouds and lightweight atmospheric fog covering the map.
Terrain: Extremely uneven and distorted terrain with rolling hills, valleys, small mountains, and deep gorges. The ground is covered with rich, highly-detailed, moving/swaying realistic dynamic grass.
🏰 World & Map Structure
Map Size: Massive, seamless open-world map.
Castles (10-11 Castles):
Massive scale, dark gothic style, breathtaking architecture.
Situated far apart from each other across the map.
Interiors: Complex layout containing rustic wooden rooms, old wooden furniture (slightly aged/weathered, not overly clean), fully furnished kitchens, medieval bathrooms, and secret chambers.
Small Houses & Looting:
Small scattered houses across the wild terrain.
Loot System: Treasure chests containing in-game currency (e.g., small houses hold around 20 coins, while major zones hold high-tier riches).
👾 Monsters & Enemies (AI Bosses)
Design: Tall, extremely terrifying wizard-like creatures with long noses and dark robes.
Behavior: Highly aggressive AI guarding high-value chest areas. They detect nearby players instantly and pursue them to kill.
Stats & Difficulty: Extremely overpowered (Boss level). Standard punch/unarmed attacks deal virtually zero damage to them, requiring high-tier weapons and strategy to defeat.
⚔️ Combat, Weapons & Economy
PVP & Multiplayer:
Full Open-World Free-For-All PVP enabled. Players can attack and kill any other player anywhere on the map.
Custom lobby/host settings to toggle PVP on or off for joining players.
Combat System:
Melee-focused combat with a knife/dagger progression system.
Upgrading to higher-tier knives increases damage drastically against both players and monsters.
PVP Balance: A standard precise hit with a basic/default knife takes around 10 direct hits (10 damage instances) to eliminate an enemy player.
Shops & Vendors:
Small, beautiful, illuminated shop huts glowing warm light into the dark night.
Full Buy/Sell system allowing players to purchase upgraded knives, items, and sell looted treasures/items.
🐎 Travel & Exploration
Mounts: Rideable horses for fast travel across the vast terrain and valleys.

answers.ask: How far apart should the castles be — a few minutes ride, or long enough that horses are essential?
answers.answer: Place castles far enough apart that horses are essential for practical travel between them; crossing on foot should take a long time.

answers.ask: Must the world be genuinely seamless, or is it acceptable for castle interiors and outlying regions to load as separate zones?
answers.answer: The main world should be genuinely seamless as specified, but castle interiors may load as separate zones to keep the build practical.

config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this RPG map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Open World with Biomes: Regions whose difficulty and reward scale with distance — tougher wildlife and scarcer resources further out.

INCLUDE:
- Unclaimed Territory: Broad open buildable land where players and tribes raise their own bases anywhere they like.
- Resource Veins: Repeating alcoves and clearings reserved for mining seams, woodcutting stands, and herb patches.
- Regional Waypoint: Distant structures that let a player orient themselves across a large world.
